name: Being A Good Husband
overview: Scripture reveals that being a good husband involves cherishing and rejoicing with the wife of one's youth, recognizing her as a blessing and favor from the Lord. Marriage is a sacred union where a man leaves his parents to cleave to his wife, becoming one flesh. Love within this relationship must be sincere and rooted in goodness, rejecting evil, while faithfulness is upheld by honoring the permanence of marriage except in the case of fornication. Additionally, husbands are called to respond to challenges with grace and blessing rather than bitterness.
